scope: Research the exact GDAL DXF comparator route and downstream FreeCAD boundary; refine existing 3D carrier and validation subplans without inferring local defects or promoting support claims.

method.kind: Primary GDAL and Autodesk documentation, official current-release page, FreeCAD project documentation and maintainer issue report, cross-checked against the existing plan
method.scopeLimit: Public documentation establishes candidate capabilities and exclusions, not execution of this repository's output. The documented Binary DXF reader and AC1027+ 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE are not explicitly qualified in combination; test that combination before admitting it as a comparator cell.

evidence.topic: GDAL read-only feature route versus binary-DXF direct-transcode shortcut
evidence.observed: The DXF driver documentation says binary DXF reading starts in GDAL 3.12; its AC1027+ 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE exposes raw ASMData and a 12-real ASMTransform but does not produce OGR solid geometry. INLINE_BLOCKS=NO preserves block definitions and references as separate layer/features and fields. The same docs say no-option ogr2ogr binary-DXF to ASCII conversion follows a direct-conversion path. The current release page lists GDAL 3.13.3, released 2026-08-18.
doesNotEstablish: that the direct-conversion path executes the GDAL DXF feature reader
that every GDAL build supports binary-DXF input and 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE together
ACIS/ASM interpretation, valid B-rep construction, or shape equivalence
evidence.planUse: Use read-only ogrinfo for open/read diagnostics and a small optional GDAL API probe when exact binary ASMData extraction is required. Enable 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE; set INLINE_BLOCKS=NO for block-owner checks and capture block reference fields separately from per-entity ASMTransform. Probe model-space, block-owned, ASCII and Binary DXF cells separately. Label no-option ogr2ogr conversion as direct-transcode/syntax evidence only. Pin exact GDAL build; if capability composition is absent, mark the comparator cell not applicable rather than a libdxfrw failure.

evidence.topic: DXF modeler payload contract and history edge
evidence.observed: 3DSOLID, BODY, REGION and SURFACE reference pages define AcDbModelerGeometry, modeler-format group 70 and repeated proprietary modeler-data string groups 1/3. The 3DSOLID page additionally defines a history-object reference. These wrappers identify where modeler payload and history linkage live, but do not specify the complete internal ACIS/ASM grammar.
doesNotEstablish: that group 310 proxy graphics is the 3D modeler payload
the semantic meaning or validity of the inner SAT/SAB/ASM stream
that entity presence alone proves owner/history/AcDs closure
evidence.planUse: Keep wrapper class, handle/owner, ordered group-1/3 payload reassembly, applicable history handle, DWG AcDs links and shape semantics as separate assertions.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD stock route is not a 3D ACIS acceptance oracle
evidence.observed: FreeCAD documentation says its stock DXF importer cannot read ACIS/SAT blobs and DWG import proceeds by converting to DXF before using the DXF importer. In issue #18454 a maintainer confirms the reported 3D solids use ACIS blobs that stock FreeCAD cannot read.
doesNotEstablish: that an ignored ACIS entity is malformed or lost by libdxfrw
the behavior of a separately installed ACIS plugin or converter
evidence.planUse: Retain the configured FreeCAD DWG-to-DXF-to-import path as a 2D consumer gate. Mark stock ACIS consumer cells not applicable unless a specific ACIS-capable plugin/converter is recorded. Keep 3D semantic acceptance on an independent compatible reader/kernel gate.

optionalComposedComparator.candidatePin: GDAL 3.13.3; update only with an exact release/build and recorded provenance
optionalComposedComparator.readerMode: Read original input with GDAL DXF feature reader/API and 3D_EXTENSIBLE_MODE=YES; use INLINE_BLOCKS=NO for block/owner checks; do not use the no-option ogr2ogr direct-conversion path as a readback substitute.
record: separate INSERT block name, scale, angle and OCS placement where applicable
optionalComposedComparator.interpretation: Raw-carrier/association differential only; no B-rep or support-claim promotion. Probe binary plus 3D mode composition before comparing it.

fastPerSliceChecks: locally generated in-memory or temporary ASCII/Binary DXF carrier control
touched strict build and existing focused fast test
relevant LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 compile or compatibility target
composedChecksOnly: one optional pinned GDAL raw-carrier comparison after related carrier slices compose
one independent SAT/SAB reader/kernel profile check after exact payload binding is available
implementationReadiness.fixturePolicy: No downloaded or newly checked-in drawing fixture; generate locally in memory or a temporary directory.
implementationReadiness.consumerDisposition: Stock FreeCAD ACIS route is CONSUMER_NOT_APPLICABLE absent an identified ACIS-capable plugin/converter; its 2D compatibility check remains in scope.
